sample_unit: simulated elderly persona agents (personality consistency assessments)
unlisted_practices: Adding structured cognitive conceptualization diagrams (CCD) to LLM persona prompts to improve personality consistency
Adding long-term memory module to LLM agents to reduce personality drift
Domain-specific LoRA fine-tuning on CHARLS-derived instruction pairs to improve persona stability
Psychometric validation (Cronbach's alpha, ICC, role discrimination) of LLM simulated patient agents

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmark/simulates a new platform (Elder-Sim) for elderly digital twin agents and evaluates architectural components (memory, CCD, LoRA) on personality consistency metrics; it does not evaluate organizational deployment guardrails or implementation practices.
